title: Positive: self-service data export and account deletion work (9/10; files: F-014)
standards: Ethiopia Proclamation 1321/2024 (data subject rights) — confirm with counsel
expected: Machine-readable export without secrets; deletion confirmed by password and intent; identity removed.
actual: Export is JSON covering profile, content and activity tables and excludes password hash, OTP and reset token. Deletion requires the password and typing DELETE; afterwards sign-in fails, the old token is refused, the users row is anonymised and the profile removed. Only failure: stored files remain (F-014).
